text:
melissa_cs: FYI we have AcmeCorp EBR scheduled Thurs 10am PT. Need a quick sync on slide readiness, the renewal ask framing, and an enablement follow-up plan.
melissa_cs: Please drop final slide versions and owner initials into the deck by Wed noon. Link: https://redwood.slides/acme-acme-ebr-final 
jordan_csm: I'll cover onboarding health + adoption highlights. Quick note: onboarding NPS improved but a few customers hit SSO friction last week.
rahul_success: I'll draft the renewal ask. Thinking of 9-month reserved Dedicated w/ phased migration. Will add 3 bullets of savings + pilot timeline.
olivia_eng: I'll prepare the live demo and a 45s fallback video. Also can make a short "how we handle SSO" diagram as backup.
dan_sales: Recommend we put the renewal ask no later than slide 3. Execs want to see clear ROI up front. I'll draft pricing lanes and an exec ask script.
sara_ops: I'll own feedback capture: create a short post-EBR survey for Acme execs + ops, and a follow-up cadence doc.
melissa_cs: Good. Two renewal risks to call out in speaker notes: price pushback and the Legal SSO requirement. Add mitigation for each.
jordan_csm: For metrics to show: Week-over-week activation, trial->paid conversion, and support tickets trending. I uploaded a small sparkline image to slide 3.
rahul_success: ROI bullets (working):
1) ~30% per-token savings with batching + quantization on Dedicated
2) Predictable monthly bill vs spiky cloud spend
3) Faster inference = 2-3% uplift in checkout conversion (modelled)
Will convert to $s for the exec one-pager.
melissa_cs: Action items (please ack):
- rahul_success: final renewal ask + 1-pager (due Wed 9am)
- jordan_csm: update SLO charts + NPS note (due Wed noon)
- olivia_eng: demo + fallback video + SSO diagram (due Wed 3pm)
- dan_sales: pricing lanes + rebuttals (due Wed 3pm)
- sara_ops: post-EBR survey + follow-up template (due Fri)
jordan_csm: acked. I'll also add a short script for the "product adoption" talking points.
olivia_eng: Question: who will run the fallback clip if live demo fails? I'll need someone to hit play and confirm audio.
melissa_cs: @sara_ops can you be fallback operator? You helped with the last one.
sara_ops: Yep I can. I'll rehearse Tue runthrough.
calendar-bot: Event updated: AcmeCorp EBR 026-04-15 10:00am PT 026-04-15 11:00am PT Attendees: melissa_cs, jordan_csm, rahul_success, olivia_eng, dan_sales, sara_ops
rahul_success: Heads-up: Legal flagged SSO as a deal-breaker unless there9s a timeline. Olivia's 6-week ETA should be in notes + proposed interim workaround (IP allowlist + temporary SAML proxy).
dan_sales: I'll include an "SSO commitment" option in pricing lanes (discounted if roadmap milestone met).
melissa_cs: Please add explicit next steps on slide 2: "Agree pilot -> 30-day pilot -> commit to reserved" and include owners. That makes the path-to-commit clear.
jordan_csm: Also adding a small "Risks & Mitigations" box on slide 4.
melissa_cs: Final rehearsal Tue 4pm PT. If anyone can't make it, DM me. Deck lock target: Tue 5pm PT.
rahul_success: I'll circulate PDF + 1-pager Wed 8am PT.
melissa_cs: Thanks team. Copy of slide owners for notes:```
S1: jordan_csm (Customer health)
S2: rahul_success (Renewal ask + next steps)
S3: jordan_csm (Metrics & adoption)
S4: olivia_eng (Demo + SSO fallback)
S5: dan_sales (Pricing lanes + exec ask)
```
melissa_cs: Ping if anything blocks. Want clean handoff to execs and a clear post-EBR follow-up plan.
